details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> meta : handle host views (#30217) * meta : handle views of tensors allocated on the host A view shares the memory of its view_src, so ggml-alloc never allocates a view in the buffer of the split it lands in - the scheduler copies the source into the split and the ops that use the view read that copy. The view node itself is a noop and does not need a split of its own, but the meta backend asserted when one was left inside a meta split: - ggml_backend_meta_get_split_state() dereferenced tensor->buffer->context - the graph rebuild mapped every node with ggml_backend_meta_buffer_simple_tensor() Accept such nodes when they are views of host tensors, which also generalizes the previous s_copy_main workaround. This fixes the assert hit by KV cache views when using --split-mode tensor with partial offload. Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next * archs : re-enable sm tensor for K2 Horizon * cont : add TODO and reference </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Atte
